SELECT dcr10_mail_history_id AS mail_history_id , dcr10_apr_id AS apr_id , to_char(dcr10_send_time,'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') AS send_time_string , f_emp_kor_nm(dcr10_person_id) AS person_name , dcr10_sender_email AS sender_email , dcr10_receiver_email AS receiver_email , dcr10_referencer_email AS referencer_email , dcr10_title_text AS title_text , dcr10_body_text AS body_text FROM dcr10_mail_history WHERE 1=1
AND dcr10_apr_id IN ( SELECT apr03_appr_id FROM apr03_relate_fund WHERE apr03_fund_id = #{fundId} )
AND dcr10_sender_email LIKE ( SELECT emp01_email_addr FROM emp01_person WHERE emp01_person_id = #{empId} LIMIT 1 )
AND dcr10_sender_email IN ( SELECT cmp10_email_addr FROM cmp10_mail_book INNER JOIN cmp11_mail_role ON cmp11_mail_book_id = cmp10_mail_book_id WHERE cmp11_person_id = #{empId} )
AND dcr10_person_id = #{empId} AND to_char(dcr10_send_time,'yyyymmdd') BETWEEN replace(#{startDate},'-','') AND replace(#{endDate},'-','') AND UPPER(dcr10_title_text) LIKE UPPER(#{titleText}) ORDER BY dcr10_send_time DESC

SELECT sys10_file_id AS file_id , sys10_file_nm AS file_name FROM sys10_file INNER JOIN dcr11_mail_file_history ON dcr11_file_id = sys10_file_id WHERE dcr11_mail_history_id = #{mailHistoryId} AND dcr11_mail_history_id IN ( SELECT dcr10_mail_history_id FROM dcr10_mail_history WHERE dcr10_person_id = #{empId} )
